name: jNotes
description: Milkdown Crepe WYSIWYG markdown editor with embedded Hermes agent

guiActions.name: replaceDocument
guiActions.description: Replace the entire open markdown document with new markdown (user reviews in UI)

guiActions.name: insertMarkdown
guiActions.description: Insert markdown at the current cursor (or as a new block)

parameters.name: inline
parameters.description: Insert as inline text when true

guiActions.name: appendMarkdown
guiActions.description: Append markdown at the end of the document

guiActions.name: getDocument
guiActions.description: Return the current markdown body and file path for the agent

guiActions.name: saveDocument
guiActions.description: Save the open document to disk; provide a path for an untitled note

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Optional path relative to joshu's files

guiActions.name: newDocument
guiActions.description: Start a blank untitled note in the editor (does not delete files)

guiActions.name: openFile
guiActions.description: Open a markdown file under joshu's files (relative path)
